story.title: Massive Protest in Lyon Sees Clashes and Tear Gas Amid Nationwide Strike
story.summary: Up to 55,000 people participated in a march in Lyon as part of a nationwide strike focused on wages and purchasing power. The demonstration turned violent as police charged at protesters and deployed tear gas during clashes along the route.

timeline_highlights.title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
timeline_highlights.summary: A youth group known as the 'Cockroach' movement has threatened to resume mass protests unless Gyanesh Kumar resigns as head of India's election commission. This demand follows allegations of election rigging, which have also prompted opposition parties, including Congress, to join the protests. Police have responded with tear gas to disperse demonstrators.

event_overview.title: About India Elections
event_overview.subject: India Elections
event_overview.summary: India’s elections are administered by the Election Commission of India (ECI), a permanent constitutional body responsible for electoral rolls and for conducting elections to Parliament, state legislatures, and the offices of president and vice-president. The referenced protests concern political pressure directed at the leadership of that institution; the underlying issue is the governance and perceived independence of the national election authority rather than a separate electoral contest.

facts.label: Constitutional mandate
facts.value: Article 324 of the Constitution places the superintendence, direction and control of electoral-roll preparation and elections to Parliament, state legislatures, and the president and vice-president with the Election Commission of India.

facts.label: Institutional structure
facts.value: The ECI consists of a Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners; it has operated as a multi-member commission since 1993, with decisions made by majority vote.

facts.label: Appointment and term
facts.value: Under the 2023 statute, the president appoints commissioners on the recommendation of a selection committee comprising the prime minister, the Lok Sabha opposition leader (or leader of the largest opposition party if no opposition leader is recognized), and a Union cabinet minister nominated by the prime minister. The term is six years or until age 65, whichever comes first, with no reappointment.

facts.label: Removal protections
facts.value: The chief election commissioner may be removed in the same manner and on the same grounds as a Supreme Court judge; other election commissioners may be removed only on the chief election commissioner’s recommendation.

facts.label: Electoral scope
facts.value: The ECI administers national and state-level elections, including elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha and state legislative assemblies, as well as presidential and vice-presidential elections. The normal term of the Lok Sabha is five years, although it may be dissolved earlier.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline captures the September 25, 2026 protest development involving India’s election leadership, but it does not provide a comprehensive record of India’s electoral administration, legal disputes, election results, or the unrelated protest developments listed for Spain and France.

related_stories.title: Paraguay's President Resigns Amid Banking Crisis and Frozen Savings
related_stories.summary: Santiago Peña, the President of Paraguay, resigned following a severe banking crisis that led to the collapse of Ueno Bank. The central bank intervened, seizing the bank, which had rapidly grown to serve over 60% of the country's adult population. The crisis has raised fears among customers about the safety of their savings.
